from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document from the collection, capturing its identifying information and cause of action."""
    document_order: int | None = Field(description="Sequence position in the document collection")
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of this judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The actual cause of action/案由 stated or extracted from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    legal_documents: list[LegalDocument]
